title: Eyeshield 21
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Timid Sena Kobayakawa, who is very fast from years of running errands for bullies, is forced onto the Deimon Devil Bats American football team by its scheming quarterback Yoichi Hiruma. Playing in secret under a tinted visor as 'Eyeshield 21', Sena and a ragtag team of misfits and ex-delinquents train toward the Christmas Bowl. The long Weekly Shonen Jump series (2002-2009) is a sports comedy-drama.
life_message: It holds up courage, hard training and teamwork as the way an ordinary, timid kid becomes someone who matters.
